Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.controller

Interface GameEventListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController
public interface GameEventListener
Observer interface for game-state events in Cincuentazo.

Implementations of this interface (typically the GameController) register themselves with the TurnManager to receive notifications whenever a significant game event occurs. This decouples the game engine and turn management logic from the JavaFX view layer.

All callback methods are invoked from background threads managed by TurnManager. Implementations that update JavaFX nodes must wrap their logic in Platform.runLater(Runnable).

  • Method Details

    • onTurnStarted

      void onTurnStarted(Player player)
      Called at the beginning of a player's turn, before any card is played.

      Use this to highlight the active player in the UI or to enable interactive controls for the human player.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose turn is starting

    • onCardPlayed

      void onCardPlayed(Player player, Card card, int newSum)
      Called immediately after a player successfully plays a card onto the table.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player who played the card
      card - the Card that was played
      newSum - the updated accumulated sum on the table after the play

    • onCardDrawn

      void onCardDrawn(Player player, Card card, int deckSize)
      Called after a player draws a card from the deck.

      This happens when a player cannot make a valid play and must draw instead (depending on game rules), or during the initial deal.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player who drew the card
      card - the Card that was drawn
      deckSize - the number of cards remaining in the deck after the draw

    • onPlayerEliminated

      void onPlayerEliminated(Player player)
      Called when a player is eliminated from the current game.

      A player is eliminated when they have no valid cards to play and cannot escape the forced loss condition.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player who was eliminated

    • onGameOver

      void onGameOver(Player winner, int totalRounds)
      Called when the game ends, either because only one player remains or a terminal condition is reached.
      Parameters:
      winner - the winning Player, or null if there is no winner
      totalRounds - the total number of rounds that were completed

    • onInvalidMove

      void onInvalidMove(String message)
      Called when an attempted move is rejected as invalid.

      Common causes include the human player clicking a card that would push the sum above 50, or a machine player failing to find a valid card.

      Parameters:
      message - a human-readable explanation of why the move was rejected
